description:
modules/traegerview — GET /traeger/schools/utilization (#4713, ADR 0241): the
Träger row, the school IDs of the Träger, the school rows, the child of each
approved enrollment with the running phases, the care offering bookings of
the window, the check-ins per day, the room days and the room names for the
whole school set in one administrative transaction. Flat in the number of
schools.
